notes: Auditor's two main findings are valid and accepted with one correction: the Inverted Hammer addition is a plain introChart markPoint, NOT a 'revealMarkPoint' (introChart has no quiz/reveal mechanism). The idx0 'Marubozu' mislabel is fixed by relabelling to 'Bullish' rather than retargeting to idx15 (which would duplicate the existing idx15 Marubozu pin). Rejected the auditor's low-confidence Spinning Top suggestion: no distinct spinning-top candle is authored, so pinning one would invent a level the chart does not contain. lessonChart ('Wicks Tell the Story') is a concept illustration of exhaustion wicks, not a trade setup, so Entry/Stop/Target are correctly absent; its two markPoints fully cover the taught events. quiz.chart correctly hides the outcome behind cutIndex:12 with the Demand Zone as the only pre-cut context and Hammer!/Bounce routed to revealMarkPoints — no pre-reveal spoiler. All proposed yAxis-free additions stay within range; no coordinate issues.
